logic_errors: BusinessAnswerStreamService validates streamed LLM answers only for technical leak patterns and numeric tokens. An LLM response can still replace non-numeric deterministic facts such as city, customer, supplier, order, or carrier names while reusing allowed numbers, and apply_streamed_answer will accept it as presentation.answer. That violates the requirement that deterministic facts remain authoritative.

The patch adds _build_deterministic_answer and _build_ranking_narrative_answer, but the diff contains no call site replacing raw answer_summary with _build_deterministic_answer. Based on this patch alone, the richer deterministic ranking narrative may be dead code and the claimed fallback behavior is not proven by the diff.
suggestions: Remove or heavily whitelist internal fields such as query_plan/query_key from the LLM prompt payload instead of relying only on output validation to prevent leaks.
Constrain deterministic ranking narration to explicit ranking/TopN intents or clearly named ranking plans; plain sorted-and-limited lists can otherwise be described as ranks incorrectly.
If streaming UX matters, validate incrementally or use a post-validation release strategy; the current implementation buffers the full LLM response before yielding any chunks.
summary: Not passed. The deterministic row-based narrative itself avoids derived calculations, and apply_streamed_answer preserves structured fields by deep-copying and only changing presentation.answer/debug. However streamed LLM text can still alter non-numeric facts, and the patch does not show the new deterministic answer builder being wired into presentation generation.
